wares.name: mermaid
wares.title: Mermaid
wares.description: Diagrams from the md: a ```mermaid fence carries the diagram source; installed and enabled, the serve-time filter swaps the fence for a rendered diagram (mermaid renders it in the browser — no server, no build). An empty or malformed fence stays visible in the md: degrades, never dead.

wares.name: stop-motion
wares.title: Stop Motion
wares.description: A ```stop-motion fence in the md carries a numbered image series (0..n) + fps; installed and enabled, the serve-time filter decodes it into stacked frames and animates them — pure CSS steps-by-delay, no JS. Admin routes mint fences and re-time the speed (mint, speed). Malformed fences stay visible in the md: degrades, never dead.

wares.name: drunken-monk
wares.title: Drunken Monk
wares.description: Machine-generated payloads living plainly in the md: a ```drunken-monk fence carries a monk banner + a sealed base64 envelope; installed and enabled, the serve-time filter decodes it into style/script/html behaviour — ONLY envelopes sealed by the admin mint route (host HMAC integrity stamp; a hand-crafted fence degrades to the visible notice — editors cannot forge what admins mint). Editor keeps the monk, published page keeps the behaviour.

wares.name: catflash
wares.title: Catflash
wares.description: The one-pager: one page, many sections, an anchor nav that follows the scroll. Pristine graphite-on-paper starter — the blank slate you dress into a person.

wares.name: hello
wares.title: Hello
wares.description: The smallest possible proof of the plugin contract: one template placeholder (hello_badge) and one public API route (status). It ships inside Schmarrn as the preinstalled default plugin — deletable like any other, and installable here again whenever you want it back. Copy me to build your own.

wares.name: bienenstich
wares.title: Bienenstich (API)
wares.documentation: BIENENSTICH — the API surface. Three public routes: content (the whole published site as JSON; ?body=0 for the light index, ?type=<type> to narrow), search (?q= needle over PUBLISHED markdown only), status (heartbeat). All sit behind the plugin's own Access Keys panel: the admin holds their OWN master secret (typed in the 'input' modal or minted by 'Generate' — never shown again, never usable as ?key=, only ever compared) and issues LABELLED access keys from it. An access key is shown exactly ONCE, right after it is minted — copy it then; it never appears again. Each key can be renewed under the same label (the old key dies at once), revoked (the label stays, the key stops working), or deleted. Renewing the MASTER invalidates every access key at once. Consumers present ?key=<access key>; without a valid one every route answers exactly 'Bakery closed.' (HTTP 403, plain text) and nothing else — bots get no contract, no JSON, no crumbs. Read-only by law: never writes, never leaks a draft. Setup: install → enable → Plugins tab → Bienenstich → settings tab → set a master → + Access key → copy the key → hand the ?key= URLs to your consumers. Until a key exists the API is closed — that is the safe default.
wares.description: The CMS's API surface as a ware: one GET hands a headless consumer the whole published site as JSON — the site face plus every page with title, slug, url, tags and the rendered body (body=0 for the light index). Plus a public needle (search) and a heartbeat (status). Read-only by law: never writes, never leaks a draft, answers the same to every hand. Every public route sits behind the plugin's own Access Keys panel: the admin keeps their own master secret (never shown, never usable as ?key=) and issues labelled access keys from it — consumers present ?key=<access key>; without a valid one the API answers only 'Bakery closed.'
